known.title: Gate: shipped browser rules disagree with the Python API

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - an agent builds the basic screens and enables their shipped browser rules.
These schemas return `inviteUrl` and `resetUrl`, but Python apps inherit the shared browser specs through `src/forge/init.py:165–166`. Those specs read `data.link` in `accept-invite.spec.ts:26–28`, `reset-password.spec.ts:23–25`, and `members.spec.ts:73–77,176–180`. Consequently, invite and reset tests receive undefined links and fail even with correctly implemented screens. The sibling sign-in rule at `sign-in.spec.ts:46–48` also requires a 429 and lock-specific message, whereas the changed service returns the neutral 401 at `auth/service.py:315–317`. Update the shared rule specs to match the delivered API contracts, preserving the neutral refusal behavior.
